title: Semafad
subtitle: Brand Identity & Design
overview: This project involved developing a complete brand identity system for Semafad. The visual identity is built around a bold, refined aesthetic designed to establish a strong and memorable presence across digital and print touchpoints.
problem: Without a unified visual language, brand touchpoints can feel disconnected and fail to leave a lasting impression. Semafad needed a distinctive identity that communicates credibility and professionalism while remaining modern and approachable.
solution: A complete brand identity system spanning logo design, color palette, typography, and brand assets. The system delivers consistent, recognizable visuals designed to scale across every application.

features.title: Logo Suite
features.description: Primary logo and supporting marks designed for adaptability across light/dark themes and varying screen sizes.

features.title: Color Palette
features.description: A curated brand color system supporting visual hierarchy and consistent application across digital and print.

features.title: Typography System
features.description: Type scale and usage guidelines ensuring clear hierarchy and consistent voice across all communications.

features.title: Brand Assets
features.description: Comprehensive brand visuals and assets for consistent application across all touchpoints.

results.description: Logo, color, typography, and brand asset system
